title: My Morning Routine
paragraphs: I get up at six thirty every morning.
First, I drink a glass of warm water.
Then I read English words for ten minutes.
After that, I make a simple breakfast: eggs, bread and milk.
While I eat, I listen to a short English podcast.
It trains my ears every day.
At seven thirty, I leave home for school.
A good morning makes a good day.
translation: 我每天早上六点半起床。首先，我喝一杯温水。然后我读十分钟英语单词。
之后，我做一份简单的早餐：鸡蛋、面包和牛奶。吃饭的时候，我听一小段英语播客。它每天锻炼我的耳朵。
七点半，我离家去上学。美好的早晨带来美好的一天。

title: A Little Robot in the Hospital
paragraphs: In a hospital in Shanghai, a small robot works every day.
It carries medicine from the pharmacy to the nurses.
It never feels tired, and it never forgets the way.
The robot uses cameras to find its road.
When a person walks in front of it, it stops and waits politely.
Patients love to say hello to it.
Engineers say robots will help doctors more in the future.
But robots still need people to guide them.
Machines are fast, yet human care is warm.
translation: 在上海的一家医院里，一个小机器人每天工作。它把药品从药房送到护士站。它从不觉得累，也从不忘记路。
这个机器人用摄像头认路。当有人走在它前面时，它会停下来礼貌地等待。病人们都喜欢跟它打招呼。
工程师说，未来机器人会给医生更多帮助。但机器人仍然需要人来引导。机器很快，而人的关怀是温暖的。

title: Why Leaves Change Color in Autumn
paragraphs: In autumn, the leaves turn yellow, orange and red.
This happens because the nights become longer and cooler.
Green chlorophyll slowly goes away from the leaves.
When the green fades, other colors come out.
Yellow and orange were always inside the leaf.
Red color is new: the leaf makes it on sunny days.
A leaf with bright colors is getting ready to fall.
It gives its energy back to the tree.
Next spring, new green leaves will grow again.
translation: 秋天，叶子变成黄色、橙色和红色。这是因为夜晚变得更长、更凉。绿色的叶绿素慢慢从叶子里消失。
当绿色褪去，其他颜色就显现出来。黄色和橙色本来就藏在叶子里。红色是新产生的：叶子在晴天制造出它。
颜色鲜艳的叶子正准备飘落。它把自己的能量还给大树。明年春天，新的绿叶会再次生长。
